'''Marrovian pigs''' were a type of [[Swine|pigs]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that were [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marrovia]]. They were fed in giant [[Farm/Legends|farms]] before being processed in planet's rendering stations.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />
